risks.risk: More chunks increase embedding requests, provider cost, and database storage.

controls.description: Token bounds cap chunk counts, hashes make output stable, and only searchable children receive embeddings.

risks.residual_risk: Provider prices and corpus structure can still make an accepted chunk count too expensive.

risks.risk: Parent or neighbor expansion can consume the generation context window.

controls.description: Parent promotion is size bounded, adjacent passages are capped, and final evidence obeys one total token budget.

risks.residual_risk: A budget that fits the model can still leave too little room for conversation history or output.

risks.risk: Unreliable heading detection can create misleading section boundaries.

controls.description: Conservative heading heuristics fall back to ordered paragraph grouping and bounded parents when headings are absent.

risks.residual_risk: Typography-only headings may remain indistinguishable from short body lines without a richer layout model.

risks.risk: OCR fallback can add latency and external processing cost.

controls.description: Fallback extraction runs only when the fast PDF text is sparse and records every use as a warning.

risks.residual_risk: Large scanned corpora can legitimately require OCR on most pages and exceed normal ingestion targets.

risks.risk: Repeated overlap can return duplicate evidence and waste prompt tokens.

controls.description: Hash and range duplicate suppression runs before diversity selection, while adjacent chunks merge with exact overlap removal.

risks.residual_risk: Semantically redundant passages with different hashes and ranges may still survive deterministic de-duplication.

risks.risk: Reranking too many candidates can dominate retrieval latency.

controls.description: Only the fused top candidate pool is reranked, with separate duration metrics and configurable limits.

risks.residual_risk: A future remote or cross-encoder reranker can regress independently of deterministic local tests.

risks.risk: Schema migration or hierarchical locators can break existing citation rendering.

controls.description: Migration backfills legacy page fields and public locators preserve the old page shape while adding safe ranges.

risks.residual_risk: Previously stored malformed locators may require data repair outside the compatibility normalizer.

risks.risk: Chunk tuning against one PDF style can regress other layouts and file formats.

controls.description: Integration and property suites cover PDF layouts, OCR, tables, DOCX, Markdown, plain text, and headingless documents.

risks.residual_risk: The synthetic and curated corpus cannot represent every producer-specific parsing defect.

risks.risk: Re-indexing can overload workers, the embedding provider, or database indexes.

controls.description: One active job claims bounded batches, processes Documents sequentially, delays the next batch, and caps retries for transient embedding or persistence failures.

risks.residual_risk: A single very large Document can still saturate one worker or provider request window.
